card.name: Words just before taste or palatability
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected mention of taste, flavor or palatability, such as 'improve the' or 'alter the' in flavoring instructions. Also fires before sensory effects like discoloration.

modes.label: Improving taste
modes.description: Verbs and articles leading into 'the taste' in oral solution flavoring directions.
modes.example: Common flavoring syrups may be added to the solution to<< improve>> the taste for oral administration.

modes.label: Palatability
modes.description: Words leading to palatability or tolerability of an oral product.
modes.example: The solution<< is>> more palatable if chilled prior to administration

modes.label: Discoloration
modes.description: Start of 'discoloration' of teeth or color-change effects, near sensory appearance.
